title: AI Generated Mech TCG Card Prototype.
author: CulveDaddy
selftext:
Everything, except the text Al generated.  😳 

Let me know your thoughts on this card design so far.  😊

comments.author: cantthinkofausrnme
comments.body: Cool looks clean how did you make it look so clean woah

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body: Even the layout is generated? I am working on a card game myself but did the layout in Inkscape, but your looks very clean, I would not expect even gpt-4o to be able to generate it so evenly.

comments.author: MisterGabbo
comments.body: Can you please tell us more info about the process and tools you used? Well done by the way

replies.author: CulveDaddy
replies.body: The generation of the frame determined to the flow of the layout. Each was AI generated. I layered and positioned everything together in Canva. This involved many iterations, both for the generation of the individual assets and to the layout. ChatGPT helped with reviewing those iterations.
